# The Yoga Sensei

> An independent yoga editorial at theyogasensei.com, written and edited by Marvin Smit. Honest, research-based yoga gear guides and calm pose tutorials: no fake lab tests, sources cited, and clear notes on when *not* to buy a product or practise a pose.

Key facts:

- Every article is written and edited by Marvin Smit, a long-time practitioner (not a certified instructor — stated on every page).
- Product recommendations are research-based (public specifications + aggregated reviews across platforms). When a product has been personally used, that is disclosed explicitly.
- The site earns Amazon Associates commissions; commissions never influence which products are recommended. Disclosure on every commercial page.
- Health and wellness claims link to primary sources (NCCIH, peer-reviewed studies, CDC).
- The Yoga Sensei is not affiliated with "Yoga With Tim" (Tim Senesi) — a different, unrelated entity.
- Official profile: https://www.pinterest.com/theyogasensei/

- [Best yoga mats 2026](https://www.theyogasensei.com/reviews/best-yoga-mats): seven picks compared by material, grip, cushion and trade-offs

- [How thick should a yoga mat be](https://www.theyogasensei.com/guides/how-thick-should-a-yoga-mat-be): 3mm–10mm compared by practice style
- [Best yoga mat for hot yoga](https://www.theyogasensei.com/guides/best-yoga-mat-for-hot-yoga): wet grip and sweat handling
- [Best yoga mat for bad knees](https://www.theyogasensei.com/guides/best-yoga-mat-for-bad-knees): cushion vs stability
- [Best yoga mat for beginners](https://www.theyogasensei.com/guides/best-yoga-mat-for-beginners): five picks by budget
- [How to clean a yoga mat](https://www.theyogasensei.com/guides/how-to-clean-a-yoga-mat): per-material care routines
- [How to store a yoga mat](https://www.theyogasensei.com/guides/how-to-store-a-yoga-mat): roll direction, hanging, bags
